clue.text: Detailed list few find flexible

indicators.note: de-tailed means with the tail cut off, so the word list loses its final letter

parts.note: taken as written before its tail is cut
a few means some

explanation.surface: A detailed list of items turns out to be surprisingly adaptable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Detailed' reads as 'thorough' but means 'tail removed': LIST loses its last letter to give LIS.
explanation.definitionFit: Lissome describes a supple, lithe body, one that bends easily.

clue.text: A match for the devil

explanation.definitionFit: A lucifer is an old friction match; Lucifer is a name of Satan.

clue.text: Have a meal, then sit and think

parts.note: to sup is to eat supper
to sit for a portrait is to pose

explanation.surface: After dinner, someone settles down to ponder.
explanation.definitionFit: To suppose is to believe or assume, a sense of think.

clue.text: The hunter will go on about port!

indicators.note: the word on goes about, that is around, the port

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port

explanation.surface: A hunter keeps talking endlessly about a harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go on about' looks like 'talk at length about', but 'will go' is only a link and 'about' signals the wrapping.
explanation.definitionFit: Orion is the mythical giant hunter, also a constellation.

clue.text: A little white flower highly regarded in Europe

definitions.text: A little white flower highly regarded in Europe

parts.words: A little white flower highly regarded in Europe
parts.note: a small white Alpine bloom, growing high up, prized in Austria and Switzerland, whose German name means noble white

explanation.definitionFit: The edelweiss is a small white-bracted mountain plant of the European Alps.

clue.text: A journalist saying this can be cutting

parts.note: a hack is a slang name for a jobbing journalist
a saw is an old proverb or saying

explanation.surface: A reporter's remark might be described as cutting.
explanation.definitionFit: A hacksaw is a fine-toothed saw used for slicing through metal.

clue.text: Sound article for me

parts.note: a hum is a low continuous sound
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A grammar point: what sort of word is me?
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the single word 'me': the speaker is a person.
explanation.definitionFit: I, the speaker, am a person, a member of humankind.

clue.text: Red cotton all in knots

indicators.note: letters tied in knots are tangled into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A skein of red thread is hopelessly tangled.
explanation.definitionFit: Contorted means twisted out of shape, as knotted thread is.

clue.text: Verses among the tersest in an anthology

indicators.note: among says the letters sit within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Some poems are found among the briefest in a collection.
explanation.definitionFit: A sestina is a poem of six six-line stanzas plus an envoi.

clue.text: Carry on about a way loss is being made

indicators.note: the carry-on word goes about, that is around, the other pieces

parts.note: to wage war is to carry it on
St is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: Continuing in a certain manner is making a loss.
explanation.definitionFit: Wastage is the amount lost through waste or leakage.

clue.text: Fancy putting a hundred on a charge!

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for one hundred
a charge is the price asked

explanation.surface: Someone imagines staking a hundred pounds on a bet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' just places C ahead of A PRICE, as one writes a down-reading charade.
explanation.definitionFit: A caprice is a whim or sudden notion, which is one sense of a fancy.

clue.text: Drawbacks of writing about popular practice

indicators.note: the abbreviation for writing goes about, that is around, the other pieces

parts.note: MS is the abbreviation for manuscript, a piece of writing
in means fashionable or popular
use means habitual practice, as in custom and use

explanation.surface: An essay discusses the downsides of some fashionable habit.
explanation.definitionFit: Minuses are disadvantages or negative points, the opposite of pluses.

clue.text: Frown and moon around in future

indicators.note: around suggests the letters are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone sulks and mopes about what lies ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures someone sulking; 'and' only joins the two fodder words.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means from this moment onwards, henceforth.

clue.text: The board expected to answer by letter

definitions.text: The board expected to answer by letter

parts.words: The board expected to answer by letter
parts.note: a seance board whose pointer is meant to spell out replies letter by letter; its name joins French and German words for yes

explanation.definitionFit: A Ouija board bears the alphabet so that spirits can supposedly spell messages.

clue.text: A bird seen about late in the day

parts.note: re is Latin-derived for about or concerning
eve is the evening, the late part of the day

explanation.surface: A bird is spotted flying around at dusk.
explanation.definitionFit: A reeve is the female of the ruff, a wading sandpiper.

clue.text: Turning a name into an issue

indicators.note: turning the letters means twisting them into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone's name becomes a subject of debate.
explanation.definitionFit: An emanation is something that flows out or issues from a source.

clue.text: The Italian left with a gibe when disturbed

parts.note: il is the Italian word for the
a tease is a mocking jibe

explanation.surface: An Italian walks away after a taunt, upset.
explanation.definitionFit: Being uneasy or uncomfortable is being disturbed in mind.

clue.text: The boor interrupted by a woman's attacks

indicators.note: the boor is broken into by the next pieces, which go inside

parts.note: a lout is a boorish oaf
a woman's means she's, a woman is

explanation.surface: A rude man is cut short by a woman who goes on the offensive.
explanation.definitionFit: Lashing out is striking or rounding on someone violently.

clue.text: Judges a rider's about to crack up

indicators.note: the rider's letters go about, that is around, the praise

parts.note: a PS (postscript) is a rider, something added to a letter
to crack up is to praise highly, as in not all it is cracked up to be

explanation.surface: A jockey seems about to break down under the strain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rider' is not a horseman but an addition to a document; 'crack up' is not collapse but praise.
explanation.definitionFit: Appraising is assessing worth, so one who appraises judges value.

clue.text: Perplexed, as a lot's not right

indicators.note: letters that are not right are wrong, so they are put in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Confused because a great deal is amiss.
explanation.definitionFit: Being puzzled and unsure what to do is being perplexed.

clue.text: A person planning to spend time idly-about fifty

indicators.note: the idling word goes about, that is around, the Roman fifty

parts.note: to potter is to pass time doing trivial things
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Someone with schemes spends time loafing around at fifty.
explanation.definitionFit: A plotter is a schemer, someone who devises plans.

clue.text: Keep back bread for distribution

indicators.note: distributing the letters means scattering them into a new order

explanation.surface: Bread is held in reserve to hand out later.
explanation.definitionFit: To debar is to exclude or bar someone, keeping them out.

clue.text: The thinker holds it to be a great country

indicators.note: holds means the first word contains the next

parts.note: a brain is a clever person, a thinker

explanation.surface: A philosopher considers it a fine nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Great Britain is the island nation of England, Scotland and Wales, often shortened to its second word.

clue.text: Orderly having to pull up and back around

indicators.note: the back word goes around the other piece

parts.note: the rear is the back

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to lug is to pull or drag

explanation.surface: A hospital orderly must haul a patient up and turn them over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Orderly' looks like a hospital porter but is the adjective; 'up' turns the pulling word and 'around' wraps the back word about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Regular means methodical and in order, so orderly.

clue.text: A bouquet? There's a romantic beginning!

indicators.note: the beginning of the word romantic is taken with the a before it

explanation.surface: A bunch of flowers is the start of a love affair.
explanation.walkthrough: A is kept whole and 'beginning' takes ROMA, the start of 'romantic'.
explanation.definitionFit: Bouquet is used of a wine's scent, its fragrance.

clue.text: Quiet serving men shaving and grooming

parts.note: p is piano, the musical direction for soft or quiet
RE is the Royal Engineers, men serving in the British army
a paring is a thin shaving cut off something

explanation.surface: Silent valets shave and groom their master.
explanation.definitionFit: Preparing someone, getting them ready, is grooming them for a role.

clue.text: A portion of food taken to church

parts.note: a pie is a type of food
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone brings a share of the meal to church.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece is a part or share of something.

clue.text: The scene of conflict near a roundabout

indicators.note: a roundabout route twists things, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A battle takes place near a traffic circle.
explanation.definitionFit: An arena is a place of combat, originally for gladiators.

clue.text: Striking seal-it's huge

parts.note: workers on strike are said to be out
size is a gluey wash used to seal porous surfaces such as plaster

explanation.surface: An impressive seal turns out to be enormous.
explanation.definitionFit: Outsize means larger than the normal size, very big.

clue.text: Superior wear?

explanation.surface: A question about clothes of better quality.
explanation.definitionFit: Over all means ranking above everything, superior; an overall is a protective coat or garment worn over clothes.

clue.text: Skip Oriental gin

parts.note: to spring is to jump or skip
E for east, the Orient

explanation.surface: Someone skips a glass of Asian spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: A gin is a snare or trap, and a springe is a noose snare for small game.

clue.text: Coach transport provided with a certain hesitation

parts.note: a train is a form of transport
er is the sound of someone hesitating

explanation.surface: A coach company hesitates over its train service.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainer instructs athletes, as a sports coach does.
